gloss: regular day off, regular closing day

definitions.gloss: regular day off, regular closing day
definitions.explanation: A fixed day of the week or month when a store or business is closed. Often displayed on signs and in business listings.

examples.japanese: {定休日|ていきゅうび}は{水曜日|すいようび}です。
{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}で{定休日|ていきゅうび}はありません。
examples.english: We're open year-round with no regular days off.

examples.japanese: {行|い}く{前|まえ}に{定休日|ていきゅうび}を{確認|かくにん}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should check the regular closing day before going.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}：{月曜日|げつようび}: Closed on Mondays
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}：なし: No regular closing day
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}：{不定休|ふていきゅう}: Irregular closing days

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the closing day
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}なし: no regular days off

RELATED WORDS:
- {営業|えいぎょう}{時間|じかん}: business hours
- {年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}: open year-round
- {臨時|りんじ}{休業|きゅうぎょう}: temporary closure
